steps.content: Alarms blare throughout the laboratory deep within the Restricted Area.

steps.speaker: Researcher A
steps.content: Hilda's M-Value is spiraling again! Contamination is off the charts!

steps.speaker: Researcher B
steps.content: The Chief's levels are climbing too, but still within the controllable range due to suppression by the shackles.

steps.speaker: Researcher A
steps.content: Hilda's Mania is flaring; it's creating a feedback loop to the Chief... Wait, what?! She knows about LINK?!
Faint, barely visible electrical currents ripple across Schorl. Minutes later, it speaks, its composure icy as it begins issuing orders.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Continue monitoring and prepare to activate the mandatory protocol. Priority is ${PlayerName}'s safety. Regarding the subconscious incursion, if she breaches ${PlayerName}'s mental defenses, it will ultimately simplify our task.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Initiate a 15-minute countdown. Prepare the suppressant injection and stand by to terminate the LINK connection.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Notify MBCC to be on standby. If Mania exceeds the critical threshold, we will transport Hilda, alongside the tank, to the upper level, sever her connection to the Chief, and proceed with termination.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: We cannot allow her to extract any intelligence from this facility.
[Memory Space: Telegraph Background]

In the span of a few breaths, Hilda's power floods the space. Code strips unspool from your very being, cinching around your limbs and hoisting you aloft. They flutter from her fingertips like a silent, papery snow.
Your shackles and her power intertwine; your consciousness and memories knot together in a profoundly unnatural braid.

Yet she ignores the iron biting into her flesh and the corruption seeping through her veins. Her fingers, with a ghost's touch, trace the contours of your mind, coaxing your memories to unfold before her.
[Flashback Filter: Deep Restricted Area]

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Before the shackles appeared, we lacked effective means to control highly dangerous and difficult-to-manage Sinners. For humanitarian reasons, execution was not an option. So, cryosleep technology was employed to preserve them in stasis. A practice that continues to this day.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: With the latest <color=#fb9259>LINK</color> technology, we can now attempt to enter their deep consciousness and awaken their minds.
[Flashback Filter: Small CG - Containment Tank]

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: <color=#fb9259>Hilda Hartlein</color>. She was a cryptography expert working for the metropoles during the First Outland War.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: We hope you can extract more information on the "Monolith" system and "Outlands Sinners." Specifically, we need to understand how the metropoles secured the allegiance of such a powerful Sinner in an era when they were exceptionally rare, and whether any secret technology was involved.
[Memory Space]

She doesn't just watch your memories; she forces you to relive them with her. Together, you see Schorl introducing you to LINK... the collective decision to select her as the target... your approach to the Sinner's containment pod. You see your past self look up, your own eyes calmly conveying the message: I will complete the mission.
She makes you an unwilling participant in this twisted retrospective, forcing you to "appreciate" the betrayal alongside her.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: Fascinating, isn't it? Are you afraid of the guiltiness when your lies are laid bare? Or do you fear the truth is too cruel for me to bear?
She grabs a code strip and gives it a deliberate tug, yanking you closer to her.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: It's really not difficult to accept. You are DisCity's hero. I am a metropole spy. We were destined to stand on opposing sides.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: You played your part perfectly, made me dance in the palm of your hand. I thought you were my only hope. I entrusted you with everything—the Monolith, the correction of my mistakes—believing you like a fool... waiting for a miracle that would never come.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: Of course you would never come back. You were always DisCity's loyal servant. Stealing the Monolith was your only objective. All that talk of correction and ideals was meaningless.
A storm finally breaks in her gaze. Anger, grief, and mockery, all crashing through at once.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: So why come back now? What else is left for you to take from me?

options: I came to save you. I mean it.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: I will not believe you again.
Her gaze locks with yours, every word measured and sharp as a blade.
The raw, near-desperate intensity in her eyes pains you. An invisible hand seems to clamp around your throat, stealing your breath and your voice. You try to form words, but only silence emerges.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: You still cannot control your tells. I am perfectly fine now. So why do you look at me with such pity? What are you hiding from me this time?
You instinctively recoil, but she's faster. Her hand darts out, her fingers firm as they grasp your chin, holding you in place.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: We have all the time in the world. I will use my power to strip your secrets away, layer by layer, until I see what truly lies in your heart...

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: ...I will not fall into your trap again.
Her words are a soft whisper, but her fingers tighten like a vise. More code strips of your memory surge from within you, a torrent that makes your very consciousness shudder.
[Flashback Filter: Restricted Area]

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Welcome back, Chief. The results of this LINK session appear to be satisfactory on all fronts. You have successfully retrieved the Monolith, and the data concerning the metropoles and the Ash Crystals constitutes entirely new intelligence for us.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: We will now begin analyzing Hilda's brain to extract the "Monolith" within. Please rest here for the moment; you may review the findings once you have recovered.
[Flashback Filter: Laboratory]

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: After prolonged confinement in a contaminated environment, Hilda's consciousness and memories were already fragmented. Because you continuously input new memory segments during the LINK process, her cognitive functions have begun to show signs of confusion.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: She mistakenly believes that the "memories" you constructed for her are her actual past, that you truly rescued her and took all her hopes away from that place.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: On this foundation, her mind has reconstructed memories spanning decades. In her perception, she has been waiting for you to return and fulfill your promise ever since the day you left, but her wait has yielded nothing but silence.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Mania is a mutation of the mind, and memory is the vessel of consciousness. Decades of accumulated despair and breakdown erupted in an instant, causing the Mania within her to spiral completely out of control.
[Background: Mania-Contaminated Consciousness Space]
She watches in continued silence, her eyes a fractured mirror reflecting countless shattered scenes.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: So... even my memories are fake. This is nothing but an illusion, a construct left by your manipulation of my mind...

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: I was such a fool.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: There was no betrayal, because the comrade I fought alongside never truly existed.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: What I want... is...

options: Stop torturing yourself with Mania. Come with me.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Mania will consume you completely. I want to get you out of here.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: ...Out? You mean to "wake up"?
She doesn't wait for your answer. Her hand rises. Her fingers find the scar on her throat.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: ${PlayerName}, do you know... how I survived the torture of DisCity's agents?

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: A slit throat cannot speak, so they first infused Mania Crystals into my body, using mutation to repair the damage. Once they were sure I wouldn't die, they began... every form of physical and psychological torment imaginable.
—Thoughts of suicide had whispered to her countless times. Oblivion promised a mercy this endless torture did not.
—Yet, she endured. For the faint hope of waiting for someone to come. Forced to bear the unbearable.
But she could not let them defile her. Could not let them plunder the things she held dear: the memory of her parents, the echo of her ideals, her last, fragile hopes.
If the outside world could not be trusted, if her own mind and body were nothing but a torture ground... then let a more absolute end claim it all.
Use Mania.
The command was a silent scream, a final act of will from a voice that had been stolen.
Come. Swallow me. Encase these memories. Seal my consciousness. Lock my mind away with the heaviest chains.
And with that, she severed her final tether to the world. With a self-annihilating resolve, she extended an invitation to the darkness she had long held at bay.
Afterward... her consciousness did not fall; it willingly stepped into the abyss of Mania, and was no more.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: I will not fall into DisCity's hands again.
Her words are laced with an inescapable madness.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: You are far too valuable to DisCity. Losing you would be like losing an army... So... they will not risk harming you to stop me.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: The overflowing Mania will destroy this entire Restricted Area, and you will awaken with me...
As she speaks, she tightens her grip on the code strips. A jolt of electricity instantly sears through your body.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: I just want to leave... LINK will let them see what you are experiencing. Let them watch and listen, and consider my proposal.
You gaze at her in stark silence, your teeth gritted. In her ashen-red eyes, you see no hope—only a staring abyss, spun from the threads of ruin and a deep, devouring obsession.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: If you did manage to escape DisCity... where would you go?

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: I will return to the Sevael Republic. To finish the task once entrusted to you... the one you failed to complete...
Hearing her answer, you feel nothing but sorrow.

You used the Monolith as bait, contaminated your own consciousness with Mania to hide information, waited for decades in the cracks of memory, and finally captured me to break the stalemate... All this, just to use me as leverage to force DisCity to release you? So you can return to that metropole?
You know it is rotten to the core.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: But it is still my homeland.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: Even if it is twisted beyond recognition, even if it is rotted to the bone, I will still reshape it. I will change it. I will save it.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: A city-state does not change because of one person. You are facing an entire system, a corruption rooted in human nature itself.
And you have seen with your own eyes how they corrupt and destroy people.
Yet Hilda simply shakes her head.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: Nothing is beyond change... People are the variable that influences everything. People create systems, people become corrupt, people kill—so people must also be the ones to correct these wrongs.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: Precisely because it is flawed, we need determined individuals to cut out the sickness, to defend justice, not run from it!

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: If the city-state is truly rotten, then I will cut it open and drain the poison. I now have the means. No one can hide the truth from me. I will use my power to see through everything!

She roars in defiance, a desperate attempt to convince herself. But the fracture in her resolve is laid bare, instantly detected by the unrelenting resentment that saturates the space. It answers with a howl of its own, coalescing and striking at her from every direction.

steps.speaker: Chaotic Voice
steps.content: ...Can't accept it... a lifetime devoted... for this...

steps.speaker: Chaotic Voice
steps.content: ...Surrender... to me... I can grant you power... to break free... to change it all...

steps.speaker: Chaotic Voice
steps.content: Any means necessary... survive... survive... change everything... change the city-state!!
Like moths to a flame, the tempting whispers throw themselves against the cage of the code strips, disintegrating into ash against its barrier of her power.
You watch her fight a war on two fronts, against the corrupting backlash of Mania and the grip of your own shackles. Her body trembles, swaying on the very verge of collapse.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Your war ended long ago... What we're doing now is—

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: Shut up! I said I will not believe you!!
Her hands are trembling as they cup your face. She gazes deeply into your eyes, only to find a profound compassion within.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: What else do you know? What else are you hiding from me?

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: Tell me... let me <color=#fb9259>see</color> it.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: ...Please...
More memories transform, becoming fluttering code strips that tear themselves from your body. They swarm outward, a frantic, suffocating blizzard that devours the space around you.
Pain lances through you—the excruciating tear of your consciousness, your very soul being ripped open.
...So let her see it all.
You hold her gaze as she plunges into the hidden corners of your mind, racing straight toward the truth you had buried in the deepest trenches of yourself.
[Flashback Filter: Archives]
Schorl led you to the cabinet housing the metropole archives. With practiced ease, it unlocked it.
You pulled file after file, but each one told the same date that marked the day the metropole vanished from all historical record.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: After their defeat in N.F. 82, the metropole made no efforts to correct its course. Instead, it fell deeper into corruption until it eventually fractured from within.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: As for Hilda herself, she endured extensive interrogation after her capture. Yet she never disclosed even the slightest piece of intelligence. Eventually, she attempted to erase her own consciousness using Mania, which led to her being forcibly placed in suspended animation, remaining in the Restricted Area for decades.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: What a pitiable and tragic woman. She remains completely unaware that <color=#fb9259>her homeland was destroyed long ago</color>.
[Consciousness Space]
In this moment, the entire world freezes.
In the sudden, profound silence, all feeling drains from her. You see the anger on her face melt away, leaving only naked bewilderment.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: ...What...is it saying?
You take a deep breath.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'm really sorry for giving you these painful memories.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I can't fix this for you, and we can't let you leave DisCity to save the metropole.
Because the homeland you want to change and save was gone decades ago.
